models.name: todo_list_system_settings
models.description:
System-wide application configuration and global settings table.

Provides a centralized location for storing key/value pairs, flags, and operational parameters used by the todo list application at runtime. Each row represents a distinct configuration setting. This allows for reliable, auditable modification and retrieval of system-level options, feature toggles, and environment variables.

Typical usage includes storing site-wide feature switches, maintenance flags, version numbers, and other application settings that need to be referenced by business logic or admin operations. Settings can be updated as the product evolves or undergoes upgrades, with timestamps preserving the history of changes.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies each configuration record.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique setting identifier. Used by the application code to look up configuration or environment variables. Must be unique system-wide and limited to ASCII alphanumeric with underscores.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Value assigned to the key. Can be interpreted by business logic as a boolean, integer, string, URI, or other serializable data type as needed by configuration context.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable explanation describing the business purpose, intended usage, and possible values of this setting.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Monotonic version number incremented with any setting update. Allows implementation of configuration reload, rollback, or audit scenarios.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the setting was created. Used for lifecycle tracking and change audits.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this configuration record. Reflects operational changes to settings or value modifications.

models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Registered user accounts for the Todo List application.

Each user is an independent actor who can manage their own personal todos. The model stores core identity and authentication details, including a unique email address and a securely stored password hash. Profile management features such as display name are provided for personalization, subject to length constraints. Account lifecycle and security are handled via soft deletion and timestamp fields. Only this entity serves as the origin of ownership for user-created data in the system. Soft deletion supports user-driven deactivation or admin suspension. User accounts are never accessible by other users, and all business logic enforces strict isolation of user data across the application.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for authentication. Must conform to RFC standards and be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure, one-way hash of the user password. Plain-text passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's visible profile name. Must be 2–50 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the most recent profile change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the account was soft deleted (voluntary or admin-initiated).

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Authentication session records for users.

Each session represents a single login or authentication event for a user. Sessions track login context including IP address, connection URL, and referrer as required for audit and compliance. Unique to each user, allowing multiple concurrent sessions. Expiration field is provided for immediate or scheduled logout. All session objects are managed through this table to maintain strict traceability, session duration control, and regulatory audit logging. Sessions never store tokens or device fingerprints, only raw connection context and timestamps.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user account. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address at login.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL at login.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at session start.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was explicitly ended.

models.name: todo_list_admins
models.description:
Administrative accounts for system management and oversight.

Admins maintain overall system health, enforce business rules, audit user activity, and respond to support incidents. Each admin account includes unique identification via email and secure password storage. Admins do not create personal todos, but their actions are logged for traceability and compliance. The model supports soft deletion for account revocation or security purposes. All privileged operations, such as user suspension and audit log access, are performed under an authenticated admin identity.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for admin authentication. Must conform to RFC standards and be unique among admins.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure one-way hash of the admin's password. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Visible admin profile name used for identification in audit logs. Must be 2–50 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for most recent profile or credential update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion (revocation/suspension/voluntary exit).

models.name: todo_list_admin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication session records for administrators.

Each record represents a single login session for an admin account, including IP, connection URL, and referrer details for compliance and security auditing. Sessions enable tracing of every admin action to an authenticated session and identity. Expiration datetime supports scheduled or manual logout. Multiple concurrent sessions are allowed for administrative flexibility. All privileged system operations are executed in the context of a session in this table. No personal data beyond session context and actor reference is stored here.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning admin account. {@link todo_list_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address at session start.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL used by the admin at login.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for audit traceability.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for session creation.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Main todo item entity for personal task management.

Represents an individual user-owned task, supporting the full lifecycle from creation, update, completion, to (soft) deletion. Each todo belongs exclusively to one authenticated user and is never visible to others except admins. The entity supports fast retrieval, multi-field filtering, case-insensitive searching, and provides all audit and business timestamps required for compliance and lifecycle tracking.

Field structure enforces domain rules: only non-deleted todos may share the same title for a user, completion is timestamped, and filtered list views are optimized by indexes. Temporal fields (created_at, updated_at, completed_at, deleted_at) allow robust retention, undo, and audit patterns as needed by the product.

Foreign keys, constraints, and indexes ensure data integrity and high query performance for typical CRUD and search operations.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies the todo item.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who owns this todo. References {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short title of the todo item. Required, 1-100 visible UTF-8 characters, trimmed of whitespace. Uniqueness enforced per user among non-deleted todos.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional extended description of the todo item. Up to 1000 characters. May be null or empty.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Todo status in business workflow. Allowed values: 'pending', 'completed'. Only these two values are valid in minimal version; future states can be added with migration.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was marked as completed. Null if not completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the todo item. Set when the record is first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp. Updated on every change of title, description, or status.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if not deleted; set when user deletes the todo for retention/undo window.

models.name: todo_list_audit_logs
models.description:
System audit log entries for privileged administrative events and compliance tracking.

Captures every significant admin action or sensitive event affecting user data or system configuration. Each entry includes the precise actor (admin or system service), affected target (user or resource), event type/category, timestamp, and an optional narrative or details for audit clarity.

Serves as an immutable, append-only history to ensure legal and business compliance—supporting forensics, investigation, and external audit. No audit event can be changed or deleted. Foreign keys reference existing administrator and user tables for actor/target traceability. Optimized for search and filterability on date, actor, target, and event type.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each audit event.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator responsible for the event. References {@link todo_list_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_user_id
foreignFields.description: (Optional) User account affected by the event. May be null if event does not target a specific user. References {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: The type or category of event (e.g., 'user_deletion', 'todo_removed', 'permission_changed', 'login_failed', 'system_restart'). Must be a short, machine-readable string.

plainFields.name: event_time
plainFields.description: Precise timestamp of when the event occurred (in UTC ISO8601; required for every entry).

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Optional narrative or context describing the event (who, what, why, and business reason for privileged interventions). Up to 2000 characters.
